name: positive-reverse-shell
description: Canonical reverse-shell behavior: a non-login shell (bash -i) is exec'd, opens an outbound socket to a classic callback port (4444), then redirects its stdio onto the socket via dup2 — all from one process generation (42) inside the 60s window. The bounded sequence completes cleanly (completed, not uncertain), the shell-exec condition matches, and no SSH/debug/admin/interactive exception applies. Expect exactly one correlated alert (action=alert, never deny).
